scope: Unchanged native selector on 192 valid physical/cached/uncached destinations and exact original 21-instruction prefix on 192 invalid destinations; all eight FR/SZ/PR modes and representative selector flags. Full RAM/CPU/FPU matches; guard precedes first original FMOV store at 0c905572.
limitations: Support guard only, with valid entity/appearance records. It reports an unsupported original write rather than delivering a hardware exception or completing a failed copy.
